title: Hero-image override manifest
description: Shared by earth-objects-/fleet-/mars-sites-/missions-/moon-sites-/planets-/satellites-/small-bodies-hero-overrides.json. Maps an entity id to the gallery slot promoted as its hero image, with the reason and approval date. generated_at only exists on the audit-generated files (fleet, mars-sites, missions, moon-sites); overrides may be empty.

position.description: CSS object-position for the hero's cover crops (collectible card, browse cover, panel hero), e.g. "50% 22%"; set where the centred crop cuts the subject off. Reviewed with scripts/vision/hero-crop-sheet.mjs.
